explanation: He wrote them in Greek, not Latin, partly while on military campaigns, apparently for his own eyes. Their Greek title means roughly 'to himself'. Nero's tutor Seneca was a Stoic too.

claims.text: The Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius wrote the Meditations.
Hadrian, Augustus and Nero did not write the Meditations.
The Meditations were written in Greek.
Marcus Aurelius wrote parts of the Meditations while on military campaigns.
The work's Greek title, Ta eis heauton, means roughly 'to himself'.
Seneca, Nero's tutor and adviser, was a Stoic philosopher.
